_comment: ASCENSION CATALOG (plan-ascension.md C3 step 3, D9/D26): the poison bomb. ⭐ D1 WORLD-PARITY: every number is Ignite's (id 22) verbatim — cost, radius, the 3-event burn at 1/s, the PO 2026-07-20 dot uplift. The only difference is damageTags, fire → poison. ⚑ IT CLOSES A GAP THAT WAS OPEN IN ONE DIRECTION ONLY: poison already exists in the world as something done TO the player (the venom-spider dot and the tunnel pools) and Antivenom (id 47) is the authored counter — 'the first drop pair authored against its own source'. No player skill has ever dealt it. So this is the first time a player can be on the other end of a pairing the world already balances, which is a strictly better parity story than inventing an axis. ⚑ It also means Antivenom now resists a PLAYER source; that is deliberate and harmless while PvP is out of scope (GDD), and it is worth re-reading the day PvP is not. All values [PLACEHOLDER], and they move only if Ignite's move.
name: Envenom
